title: OpenFarm Slicer Provisioning Manifest
description: Maintainer-authored declaration of which (engine, version, platform) slicer builds to fetch into the application's bundled slicer directory, and the exact URL to fetch each from. Consumed only by the dev/build-time provisioning tool (tools/provision-slicers) — never read by the running application (FR-012/FR-018). The tool never derives or guesses an asset URL from a naming pattern: each engine's release asset naming can and does change between versions, so the manifest itself is the sole source of truth — copy the real link from the engine's GitHub releases page for each platform you want. Entries are grouped engine → platform → versions (schemaVersion 4): each platform lists its own set of pinned builds, because platforms commonly need different version sets, e.g. a release with a macOS-only regression is simply left out of the MacOs list.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version for forward-compat; current = 4 (each platform carries a list of builds; schemaVersion 3's single build per platform is no longer supported).

slicers.description: Desired set of slicers to bundle. Append-only across releases by product commitment (FR-008a) — entries are added, never removed. Each engine appears at most once — all of its versions are listed under that one entry's builds.

platform.description: Target host platform for the fetched build (FR-009/FR-010).

version.description: Maintainer-chosen display version (FR-005) for this specific platform's build — stored/shown verbatim everywhere (bundle directory name, discovery, pickers, recorded values). It need not match the engine's literal upstream release tag; a maintainer may use a friendlier marketed string instead (e.g. "2.7.1" for a Bambu Studio build whose actual tag/asset-embedded string is "02.07.01.57"). It does need to stay a dotted-numeric shape (e.g. "2.2.0", "2.5.59.13", "01.10.00.00") for "newest" ordering to work meaningfully, and must stay stable once a build has shipped. Different platforms are not required to share the same version string — e.g. macOS may need to stay pinned behind Linux/Windows if a given release regressed only on macOS (or vice versa).

assetUrl.description: The exact download URL for this platform's build of the pinned version — copied verbatim from the engine's GitHub releases page (the asset filename/naming convention is not assumed or derived by the tool, since it can change between releases).

notes.description: Optional free-text maintainer note about this specific build (e.g. why it is pinned, or that it is unverified on this platform).

builds.description: Per-platform list of pinned (version, download URL) builds for this engine — every listed build is provisioned side by side. A platform omitted here is simply not provisioned for this engine (not a failure, FR-015). Platforms are independent: each lists its own version set. A version must appear at most once per platform.

notes.description: Optional free-text maintainer note for the engine as a whole (e.g. why platforms diverge).

MacOs.notes: 2.3.2 through 2.4.2 segfault on macOS, so only 2.3.1 is listed here.

slicers.notes: Linux bundles two versions side by side; macOS only the newest working one.
PrusaSlicer-fork CLI form — see SuperSlicerInvocation. SuperSlicer doesn't consistently publish macOS builds, so no MacOs builds here.
